Skill `view-pdf`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `list_pdfs` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; adds `pdfs_listed`.
Tool `display_pdf` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires any of (`pdf_available`, `pdf_url_given`); adds `viewer_open`, `view_uuid_known`.
Tool `get_pdf_text` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `viewer_open`; adds `relevant_text_obtained`.
Tool `get_pdf_screenshot` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `viewer_open`; adds `viewer_state_verified`.
Tool `add_pdf_annotations` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `viewer_open` and `user_approved_markup`; adds `annotations_applied`.
Tool `fill_pdf_form` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `viewer_open` and `form_values_known`; adds `form_filled`.
Tool `place_signature_image` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `viewer_open` and `signature_image_known` and `placement_known`; adds `signature_placed`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: any of (`viewer_open`, `annotations_applied`, `form_filled`, `signature_placed`).
Protocol:
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `open_local_pdf`:
      - `agent` uses `list_pdfs`.
      - `user` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `select_local_pdf`:
          - `agent` uses `display_pdf`.
        - branch `cancel`: none.
    - branch `open_given_pdf`:
      - `agent` uses `display_pdf`.
    - branch `cancel`: none.
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `view_only`: none.
    - branch `annotate`:
      - `agent` uses `get_pdf_text`.
      - `user` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `approve_markup`:
          - `agent` uses `add_pdf_annotations`.
          - `agent` uses `get_pdf_screenshot`.
        - branch `decline_markup`: none.
    - branch `fill_form`:
      - `agent` uses `fill_pdf_form`.
      - `agent` uses `get_pdf_screenshot`.
    - branch `sign`:
      - `agent` uses `place_signature_image`.
      - `agent` uses `get_pdf_screenshot`.
